ablations_three_frontier_candidates_uppe.assumption: three frontier candidates, four additional variants, at most three calls per case

conditional_verification_upper_bound.assumption: five policies; conditional policies costed as if verification always fires

sequential_racing_two_extra_repeats_uppe.assumption: three unresolved candidates, three calls per case, two extra repeats

role_candidates.caveat: Roles exclude partial-coverage models and remain pilot hypotheses.

scoring_sensitivity.scope: Case-specific critique taxonomy synonyms and whitespace around planning-list commas only; provider failures and other wrong answers remain failures.
